description: Foundation: types, services, utilities, and reusable UI components. Creates all TypeScript interfaces for GitHub integration and code search, API service layers (githubService, codeSearchService), error handling utilities, toast notification system (react-toastify), and common loading/skeleton components (Spinner, ProgressBar, LoadingOverlay, SkeletonCard). This FEAT establishes the infrastructure that subsequent features depend on.
steps: 1. Create src/types/github.ts with GithubOAuthUrlResponse, GithubRepository, ImportRepositoryRequest, ImportStatus, SemanticSearchRequest, SearchResult, SemanticSearchResponse interfaces. All use camelCase (apiClient transforms from backend snake_case).
2. Create src/types/project.ts with Project interface (id, name, description, repositoryUrl, createdAt, updatedAt).

3. Create src/services/api/githubService.ts with methods: getOAuthUrl() GET /github/oauth/authorize, handleOAuthCallback(code, state) POST /github/oauth/callback, listRepositories() GET /github/repositories, importRepository(request) POST /github/import (202 Accepted), getImportStatus(projectId) GET /github/import/{projectId}/status, unlinkGithub() DELETE /github/tokens. All use apiClient from ../apiClient.
4. Create src/services/api/codeSearchService.ts with semanticSearch(request) POST /code/search. Follows same apiClient pattern.

5. Create src/utils/errorHandler.ts with parseGithubError(error: unknown): string function. Handles 401 (auth failed), 403 with rate limit, 404 (not found), 429 (too many requests), 502 (GitHub API unavailable). Uses axios.isAxiosError for type checking.
6. Install react-toastify@10.0.6 exact version: cd frontend && npm install --save-exact react-toastify@10.0.6
7. Create src/utils/toast.ts with showSuccess, showError, showInfo wrappers around react-toastify toast function. Default options: position top-right, autoClose 4000ms.
8. Update src/App.tsx: import 'react-toastify/dist/ReactToastify.css' and add <ToastContainer /> before closing BrowserRouter tag.
9. Create src/components/common/Spinner.tsx: inline spinner using lucide-react Loader icon with spin animation.
10. Create src/components/common/ProgressBar.tsx: takes percentage prop (0-100), renders filled bar using --color-primary background, optional showLabel prop displays percentage text.
11. Create src/components/common/LoadingOverlay.tsx: full-screen overlay (position fixed, z-index 1000) with centered Spinner and optional message text.

12. Create src/components/common/SkeletonCard.tsx: animated shimmer skeleton (linear gradient background with keyframe animation) for loading states, takes count prop. Add @keyframes shimmer to App.css if not present.

13. Create src/components/projects/ProjectsList.tsx: maps projects array to clickable cards showing name (bold), repositoryUrl (link if present), updatedAt (formatted date). Takes onSelect callback, optional selectedId for highlighting. Shows SkeletonCard when loading prop true, empty state if no projects.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without TypeScript errors
All new types export correctly and match backend API response shapes (camelCase)
githubService and codeSearchService methods return correct types and use apiClient
parseGithubError returns user-friendly messages for common GitHub error status codes
Toast notifications appear in top-right corner with correct styling when showSuccess/showError/showInfo called
Spinner, ProgressBar, LoadingOverlay, SkeletonCard render without console errors
ProjectsList displays projects correctly with name, URL, and date formatted
verification: cd frontend && npm run build — builds successfully
cd frontend && npm run lint — no linting errors
npm run dev and test toast by calling showSuccess('Test') in browser console — toast appears top-right
Import and render Spinner, ProgressBar, LoadingOverlay, SkeletonCard in a test page — all display correctly
Render ProjectsList with mock Project array — cards display with correct formatting
findings: All foundation types, services, utilities, and UI components implemented successfully. Build completes without TypeScript errors. react-toastify@10.0.6 installed. All API service methods use apiClient pattern correctly. parseGithubError handles all required status codes (401, 403 with rate limit check, 404, 429, 502). Toast utilities wrap react-toastify with default options (top-right, 4000ms autoClose). All common components (Spinner with lucide-react Loader + spin animation, ProgressBar with percentage clamping, LoadingOverlay with fixed positioning and z-index 1000, SkeletonCard with shimmer gradient animation) render without errors. ProjectsList displays projects with formatted dates, external link icons, optional selection highlighting, loading state using SkeletonCard, and empty state message. Shimmer and spin keyframe animations added to App.css. ToastContainer added to App.tsx before closing BrowserRouter tag. No new linting errors introduced (existing warnings in AuthContext and AdminUsersPage are pre-existing).
